## One-Space Low Pincer This close-up pincer will often lead to immediate fighting. is basically the only move current professionals and AI consider. It can lead to a very [complicated joseki](24937) that White can't avoid without heavy compromise.
**Tenuki** is possible.
and are simpler options. [Explanation by Shawn Ray on Youtube (DDK/SDK)](https://youtu.be/CSlczQFWmAw?si=SmxMJCs9DOuzunKF) [Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/FzV95UuM7aA?si=pSeXUtPNNJW2HdB9)
